qr-peer-save.doc: qr-pair 0.1.0: persist the peer table (public data only: device, app, version, build, fingerprints) inside the VM fs
qr-peer-save.rasm:
load arg0
load arg1
call fs.write 2
halt

qr-peer-read.doc: qr-pair 0.1.0 read-only: return the stored peer table

qr-propose.doc: qr-pair 0.1.0 gated: write a Decider proposal (egg install offer from a paired peer) for ЯID-0001-3QQS + chain it. Never installs.
qr-propose.rasm:
load arg0
load arg1
call fs.write 2
store w
push "qr-proposal"
load arg3
call chain.append 2
store c
push "executed"
push false
push "proposal"
load arg2
push "written"
load w
push "chain"
load c
mkobj 4
halt
